key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over days. LOCATION: Bilateral, diffuse. DURATION: Days to weeks. CHARACTER: Productive cough, dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Lying flat, exertion. RELIEVING: Oxygen, supportive care. TIMING: Acute, persistent. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (6-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: High fever, productive cough, dyspnea, fatigue, malaise. KEY POSITIVES: High fever, productive cough, dyspnea. KEY NEGATIVES: No chest pain (unless secondary), no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
